question: Did nodejs/node publish a non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub release in the last 30 days ending at the latest finalized block timestamp on chain 4663 available when requested?

definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.source: Use https://api.github.com/repos/nodejs/node/releases and paginate completely. Use published_at, not created_at or tag dates.
definitions.calendar: At request time, resolve the latest already-finalized block once as toBlock. Its UTC timestamp T is the fixed end of the observation; count published_at in [T minus 2592000 seconds,T). Include the lower bound and exclude T. This is a completed historical interval, never a future block or a moving wall-clock endpoint.
